component.name: LeatherCAD
component.summary: Leathercraft patterns that print at exact 1:1 scale

description.p: Draw leathercraft patterns in real millimetres, stitch along the edge, and print a template you can cut out. A line drawn as 100 mm measures 100 mm on paper.

ul.li: Parts made of outlines, cut-outs, folds, marking lines, hardware holes, text and dimensions
Stitch lines that follow the edge, with holes at your pricking iron's pitch
Change an outline and its stitching updates itself
Problems listed, such as holes too close to the edge
Parts bigger than a sheet tiled across several sheets, never scaled to fit
A 100 mm gauge on every printed sheet, to check it with a steel rule
Export to vector PDF, SVG and DXF in millimetres

screenshot.caption: A bifold wallet drafted, with its stitch holes' pitch and spacing
The Sheets view: the pieces on the paper, as the PDF places them
